say:1:1422691201:1.text: This presence... it reeks of a Hypogean!

choice_prompt:2:1422691201.text: This presence... it reeks of a Hypogean!

say:3:1422691202:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you mean this Hypogean is the same one that infested Eclipsion?
say:3:1422691202:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you mean this Hypogean is the same one that infested Eclipsion?
say:3:1422691202:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you mean this Hypogean is the same one that infested Eclipsion?

say:4:1422691203:1.text: That would explain it. A hidden space under the Ivory Tree, a Hypogean aura matching Sal'thorin's corruption...
say:4:1422691203:1.source_cn: 一切都解释得通了。被封印在皎月树下的秘密空间，又与萨洛...

say:5:1422691204:1.text: This Hypogean must be the very same one that once tainted the Sylvan Egg... or rather, a part of it.
say:5:1422691204:1.source_cn: 这恶魔应该也是当年污染了翡绿之卵的恶魔，或者说，是它的...

say:6:1422691205:1.text: Master, are you saying this is the corruption Misarte purged from the Sylvan Egg all those years ago?
say:6:1422691205:1.source_cn: 老师，你是说这个恶魔就是当年被弥萨忒剥离出翡绿之卵的那...

say:8:1422691206:1.text: Exactly. Two thousand years ago, a Hypogean clung to the Sylvan Egg. Misarte tore away the corrupted part, but she didn't completely destroy it.
say:8:1422691206:1.source_cn: 正是如此。两千年前，恶魔寄生于翡绿之卵，弥萨忒将污染部...

say:9:1422691207:1.text: A part of it split off and manifested as a Hypofiend. It followed the Sylvan Tendril to Sal'thorin and eventually rooted itself atop Eclipsion. There, it was contained by Helthor's power.
say:9:1422691207:1.source_cn: 而它的另一部分，跟随织叶到达了萨洛克兰，最终附着在杜恩...

say:10:1422691208:1.text: But weren't all Hypogeans sealed away by Dura? How can it still—
say:10:1422691208:1.source_cn: 当年的恶魔不是都被艾雅封印了吗？怎么会——

say:11:1422691209:1.text: Perhaps it was cleverer than we thought. Hiding within the Sylvan Egg itself... it may have slipped through Dura's grasp.
say:11:1422691209:1.source_cn: 或许，它比想象中棘手。比如凭借寄生在翡绿之卵上的优势，...

say:12:1422691210:1.text: That would mean it still holds the power to provoke Misarte's wrath... and shake the foundations of the Vaduso Mountains themselves. I have to—
say:12:1422691210:1.source_cn: 看来，它有着能让弥萨忒降下惩戒，动摇瓦度索的力量。我得——

narration:18:140130411:0.text: A Hypogean hatches from the egg.
narration:18:140130411:0.source_cn: 恶魔从卵中孕育了出来。

choice:2:0:1.text: The same aura I sensed on the bow.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 跟我在杜恩加尔上感受的一致
choice:2:0:1.male: The same aura I sensed on the bow.
choice:2:0:1.female: The same aura I sensed on the bow.
